days.title: Sample: Made for good work
days.introduction: Today is about made for good work. This is sample content standing in for the real Day 17, so the words will change but the shape of the day won’t.
days.scripture_text: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
days.body_md:
**Sample text.** The real teaching for Day 17 will replace these paragraphs. They are here so the screen has a realistic amount to read on a phone.

Read the passage slowly, twice. The first time, read it for what happens. The second time, notice one word or phrase that stays with you, and sit with it for a moment.

Then think about where *made for good work* shows up in your week: in your studies or work, in how you treat people, and in your time with God.

- What does the passage say?
- What does it ask of you?
- Who could you talk to about it?
reflection_prompts: What word or phrase from the passage stayed with you, and why?
Where have you noticed “made for good work” in your life this week?
If you took today seriously, what would change tomorrow?
days.practical_action: Send a short, encouraging message to someone in your pod or your family today.
days.pod_prompt: Where did today’s theme show up in your week? Keep it short and honest.

days.title: Sample: Rest and look back
days.introduction: Day 24 is for rest, looking back and getting aligned as a pod. No new lesson today. (Sample text: the real words replace this.)
days.scripture_text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
days.body_md:
**Sample text.** Look back over the last seven days. You don’t need to remember everything: notice what stayed with you, and what you want to carry forward.

Take your time with your pod today. Read what others shared and add your own thoughts.
reflection_prompts: What stood out to you most in this module?
What do you want to carry into the next one?
days.practical_action: Write down one thing from this module that you want to keep doing.
days.pod_prompt: Where does the pod want to grow together next? Share one hope for the coming week.
